propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome value types with canonical serialization supporting provider-neutral retry coordination across Cloud and Jira DC adapters.
Establish a single fake-clock retry budget owner in the reconciler domain that permits at most three physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep per logical operation.
Implement diagnostic persistence with allowlist-first field redaction, message sanitization via the existing seam, and 512-code-point truncation per entry plus exact eight-entry overflow sentinel.

After ambiguous writes, observe the desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state produces recovered, failed/inconclusive observation produces non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden.

Retain additive-jitter backoff formula from ADR 0084 (index 0 selects [2s,3s), index 1 selects [4s,5s)) with provider delays as authoritative lower bounds that reject replay if they exceed remaining budget.
